review_candidates.title: Dynamics 365 Developer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The developer will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying custom solutions within the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement platform. YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: • Solution Development: • Collaborate with the product team (solution architect, product configuration experts) to understand the requirements and solution design • Works in close collaboration with DevOps Team, i.e. • Write and maintain clean, scalable code and assist in troubleshooting and debugging applications.
eligibility_evidence: We bring together more than 30,000 people from over 70 nationalities, coming from five continents.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: • Solution Development: • Collaborate with the product team (solution architect, product configuration experts) to understand the requirements and solution design • Works in close collaboration with DevOps Team, i.e. • 2+ years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Implementation projects • Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (or higher) preferred. • Fluent in written and verbal English Technical Expertise: • Proven experience in development of D365 Customer Engagement Apps and Mobile Apps. • Strong proficiency in JavaScript, C#, and .NET development. • Hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 SDK, Web API, and RESTful APIs.
